title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2606.11949v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study three failure modes of deployed safety classifiers: distribution shift, targeted evasion, and invalid scores from reasoning-model monitors. A reduced 800-cell subset of a pre-registered factorial (4 classifiers x 5 shifts x 20 seeds x 2 windows) gives 86.8% control-validated detection (alarm at or after onset, quiet paired no-shift stream; raw TPR 91.5%), mean latency 39.7 steps at w=100 and a classifier-by-shift crossover ($\eta^2 = 0.186$ complete-case; 0.02-0.03 under a censoring sensitivity analysis) that motivates per-classifier monitoring. Shifted corpora are mostly harmful prompts, so this detects a constructed score change, not accuracy loss. The density-ratio step of weighted conformal adaptation collapses for 3/4 classifiers in high-dimensional embeddings; PCA to 32 dimensions raises temporal-shift coverage (+33pp, +20.5pp). translated_title: 面向已部署安全分类器的在线偏移检测与保形自适应
translated_abstract: 我们研究已部署安全分类器的三种失效模式：分布偏移、针对性逃避攻击，以及来自推理模型监控器的无效分数。基于一个预注册因子实验（4个分类器 × 5种偏移 × 20个随机种子 × 2个窗口）的缩减版800单元子集，方法实现了86.8%的经对照验证的检测率（在偏移开始时或之后报警，同时在配对的无偏移数据流上保持安静；原始TPR为91.5%），在w=100时平均延迟为39.7步，并发现分类器与偏移类型之间存在交互效应（完整案例分析下η²=0.186；删失敏感性分析下为0.02–0.03），这一结果支持对每个分类器进行单独监控。由于偏移语料库大多为有害提示，该方法检测到的是构造出的分数变化，而非准确率损失。加权保形自适应中的密度比步骤在4个分类器中的3个上于高维嵌入中失效；将数据经PCA降至32维可提升时间偏移下的覆盖率（分别提升33和20.5个百分点）。一个分数分歧“金丝雀”（将一个非目标分类器与主分类器进行比较）可……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一个针对已部署安全分类器的在线偏移检测与保形自适应框架，通过PCA降维解决高维密度比失效问题，并引入分数分歧“金丝雀”机制，以高检出率和低延迟实现对分布偏移、逃避攻击等失效模式的监控与自适应保护。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes online shift detection and conformal adaptation for deployed safety classifiers, showing that PCA dimensionality reduction rescues density-ratio-based conformal methods in high-dimensional embeddings and that a score-disagreement canary enables reliable, low-latency monitoring of failure modes such as distribution shift and evasion attacks.
